      - value:
          hasMore: true

  UsersResponse:
    examples:
      - value:
          meta:
            hasMore: true
          users:
            - id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
              name: Alice Smith
              email: alice@example.com
              age: 28
              not_ignored_field: value1

              email: bob@example.com
              age: 35
              not_ignored_field: value2

      openapi: ../openapi.yml

      - value:
          id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000

          age: 25

      id:
        type: optional<string>
